name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.accept_video_selfie.AcceptVideoSelfieActivity
description: When a configured verification flow requires a video selfie, this screen explains the recording step and asks the user to accept it before recording begins. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from accepting the video-selfie step when the flow requires one.
